questions.en:
Stem cells are the body's master cells, the ______ material from which we are built.
Unlike normal body cells, they can reproduce an indefinite number of times and, when manipulated in the right way, can turn themselves into any ______ of cell in the body.
The most versatile stem cells are those found in the embryo at just a few days old.
This ball of a few dozen stem cells eventually goes on to form everything that makes up a ______ .
In 1998, James Thompson ______ that he had isolated human embryonic stem cells in the laboratory.
At last, these powerful cells were within the ______ of scientists to experiment with, understand, and develop into fixes for the things that go wrong.
questions.full:
Stem cells are the body's master cells, the ______ material from which we are built.
Unlike normal body cells, they can reproduce an indefinite number of times and, when manipulated in the right way, can turn themselves into any ______ of cell in the body.
The most versatile stem cells are those found in the embryo at just a few days old.
This ball of a few dozen stem cells eventually goes on to form everything that makes up a ______ .
In 1998, James Thompson ______ that he had isolated human embryonic stem cells in the laboratory.
At last, these powerful cells were within the ______ of scientists to experiment with, understand, and develop into fixes for the things that go wrong.

答案:
1. raw
2. type
3. person
4. announced
5. grasp

sense_groups.english: Stem cells are the body's master cells, the raw material from which we are built.
sense_groups.chinese: 干细胞是人体的主细胞，是我们身体构成的原始材料。

sense_groups.english: Unlike normal body cells, they can reproduce an indefinite number of times
sense_groups.chinese: 与普通体细胞不同，它们可以无限次地繁殖

sense_groups.english: and, when manipulated in the right way, can turn themselves into any type of cell in the body.
sense_groups.chinese: 并且，在适当操作下，可以转化为身体中的任何类型的细胞。

sense_groups.english: The most versatile stem cells are those found in the embryo at just a few days old.
sense_groups.chinese: 最全能的干细胞是那些在仅几天大的胚胎中发现的细胞。

sense_groups.english: This ball of a few dozen stem cells eventually goes on to form everything that makes up a person.
sense_groups.chinese: 这个由几十个干细胞组成的球体最终会形成构成一个人的一切。

sense_groups.english: In 1998, James Thompson announced that he had isolated human embryonic stem cells in the laboratory.
sense_groups.chinese: 1998年，詹姆斯·汤普森宣布他在实验室中分离出了人类胚胎干细胞。

sense_groups.english: At last, these powerful cells were within the grasp of scientists to experiment with, understand, and develop into fixes for the things that go wrong.
sense_groups.chinese: 最终，这些强大的细胞被科学家们掌握，可以进行实验、理解，并开发成修复出错事物的方法。

questions.name: #316 to Travel Abroad
questions.en:
In the 19th century, few people could afford to travel abroad; it was expensive and there weren't the ______ transport systems that we have today.
So curiosity about foreign lands had to be satisfied through books and drawings.
With the advent of photography, a whole new ______ of "reality" became available.
Publishers were not slow to realize that here was a large new market of people ______ for travel photography and they soon had photographers out shooting the best known European cities, as well as more exotic places further ______ .
People bought the pictures by the millions, and magic lantern shows were presented in schools and ______ halls.
Most popular of all, however, was the stereoscopic picture which ______ three-dimensional views and was considered a marvel of Victorian technology.
questions.answer:
1. mass
2. dimension
3. hungry
4. away
5. lecture
6. presented
questions.full:
In the 19th century, few people could afford to travel abroad; it was expensive and there weren't the ______ transport systems that we have today.
So curiosity about foreign lands had to be satisfied through books and drawings.
With the advent of photography, a whole new ______ of "reality" became available.
Publishers were not slow to realize that here was a large new market of people ______ for travel photography and they soon had photographers out shooting the best known European cities, as well as more exotic places further ______ .
People bought the pictures by the millions, and magic lantern shows were presented in schools and ______ halls.
Most popular of all, however, was the stereoscopic picture which ______ three-dimensional views and was considered a marvel of Victorian technology.

答案:
1. mass
2. dimension
3. hungry
4. away
5. lecture
6. presented

sense_groups.english: In the 19th century, few people could afford to travel abroad;
sense_groups.chinese: 在19世纪，很少有人能负担得起出国旅行；

sense_groups.english: it was expensive and there weren't the mass transport systems that we have today.
sense_groups.chinese: 旅行很昂贵，而且没有我们今天拥有的大众交通系统。

sense_groups.english: So curiosity about foreign lands had to be satisfied through books and drawings.
sense_groups.chinese: 所以对外国土地的好奇心只能通过书籍和图画来满足。

sense_groups.english: With the advent of photography, a whole new dimension of "reality" became available.
sense_groups.chinese: 随着摄影的出现，一个全新的“现实”维度变得可用。

sense_groups.english: Publishers were not slow to realize that here was a large new market of people hungry for travel photography
sense_groups.chinese: 出版商很快意识到这里有一个庞大的新市场，人们对旅行摄影如饥似渴，

sense_groups.english: and they soon had photographers out shooting the best known European cities, as well as more exotic places further away.
sense_groups.chinese: 于是他们很快派摄影师去拍摄最著名的欧洲城市，以及更远的更具异国情调的地方。

sense_groups.english: People bought the pictures by the millions, and magic lantern shows were presented in schools and lecture halls.
sense_groups.chinese: 人们购买了数百万张照片，魔灯表演在学校和演讲厅上演。

sense_groups.english: Most popular of all, however, was the stereoscopic picture which presented three-dimensional views
sense_groups.chinese: 然而，最受欢迎的是呈现三维视图的立体照片，

sense_groups.english: and was considered a marvel of Victorian technology.
sense_groups.chinese: 它被认为是维多利亚时代技术的奇迹。

questions.name: #317 Classified Advertisements
questions.en:
Classified advertisements placed by individuals in ______ and magazines are not covered by the Advertising Standards Authority's " ______ of practice".
If you happen to buy goods that have been wrongly described in such an advertisement, and have lost money as a result, the only thing you can do is bring a case against the person who placed the advertisement for misrepresentation or for breach of ______ .
In this case, you would use the small claims procedure, which is a relatively cheap way to sue for the recovery of a debt.
If you want to pursue a claim, you should take into account whether the person you are suing will be able to pay damages, should any be ______ .
Dishonest traders are ______ of this and often pose as private sellers to ______ the legal loopholes that exist: that is, they may claim they are not in a position to pay damages.
questions.answer:
1. newspapers
2. code
3. contract
4. awarded
5. aware
6. exploit
questions.full:
Classified advertisements placed by individuals in ______ and magazines are not covered by the Advertising Standards Authority's " ______ of practice".
If you happen to buy goods that have been wrongly described in such an advertisement, and have lost money as a result, the only thing you can do is bring a case against the person who placed the advertisement for misrepresentation or for breach of ______ .
In this case, you would use the small claims procedure, which is a relatively cheap way to sue for the recovery of a debt.
If you want to pursue a claim, you should take into account whether the person you are suing will be able to pay damages, should any be ______ .
Dishonest traders are ______ of this and often pose as private sellers to ______ the legal loopholes that exist: that is, they may claim they are not in a position to pay damages.

答案:
1. newspapers
2. code
3. contract
4. awarded
5. aware
6. exploit

sense_groups.english: Classified advertisements placed by individuals in newspapers and magazines
sense_groups.chinese: 个人在报纸和杂志上刊登的分类广告

sense_groups.english: are not covered by the Advertising Standards Authority's code of practice
sense_groups.chinese: 不受广告标准局行为准则的约束

sense_groups.english: If you happen to buy goods that have been wrongly described in such an advertisement
sense_groups.chinese: 如果你碰巧购买了此类广告中描述错误的商品

sense_groups.english: and have lost money as a result
sense_groups.chinese: 并因此遭受经济损失

sense_groups.english: the only thing you can do is bring a case against the person who placed the advertisement
sense_groups.chinese: 你唯一能做的就是起诉刊登广告的人

sense_groups.english: for misrepresentation or for breach of contract
sense_groups.chinese: 理由可以是虚假陈述或违约

sense_groups.english: In this case, you would use the small claims procedure
sense_groups.chinese: 在这种情况下，你可以使用小额索赔程序

sense_groups.english: which is a relatively cheap way to sue for the recovery of a debt
sense_groups.chinese: 这是一种相对便宜的追讨债务的诉讼方式

sense_groups.english: If you want to pursue a claim
sense_groups.chinese: 如果你想提出索赔

sense_groups.english: you should take into account whether the person you are suing will be able to pay damages
sense_groups.chinese: 你应该考虑你起诉的人是否有能力支付赔偿金

sense_groups.english: should any be awarded
sense_groups.chinese: 如果赔偿金被裁定的话

sense_groups.english: Dishonest traders are aware of this
sense_groups.chinese: 不诚实的商人对此心知肚明

sense_groups.english: and often pose as private sellers to exploit the legal loopholes that exist
sense_groups.chinese: 并经常伪装成私人卖家来利用现有的法律漏洞

sense_groups.english: that is, they may claim they are not in a position to pay damages
sense_groups.chinese: 也就是说，他们可能会声称自己无力支付赔偿金

questions.name: #318 Good News
questions.en:
"No news is good news" may be true for most of us most of the time - after all, we don't look forward to unpleasant things happening to us - but "Bad news is good news" is true for those who work in the news media, and, I suspect, for the rest of us, at least some of the time.
It is tied up with stories and our seemingly ______ need for stories.
Have you ever been ______ by a story where nothing goes wrong for the characters?
There's an ______ in a Kingsley Amis novel that nicely ______ this: the main character Jake comes home to find his wife chatting to a friend about a hairdresser both women know who has moved with his family to somewhere in Africa.
Jake listens in, expecting tales of cannibalism and such like, but no, the friend has just received a letter saying they love the place and are settling in nicely.
Jake leaves the room in ______ .
We demand to be entertained, and while we don't object to a happy ending, the characters have to have experienced loss, pain and hardship in one form or another along the way to have ______ it.
questions.answer:
1. insatiable
2. gripped
3. incident
4. illustrates
5. disgust
6. deserved
questions.full:
"No news is good news" may be true for most of us most of the time - after all, we don't look forward to unpleasant things happening to us - but "Bad news is good news" is true for those who work in the news media, and, I suspect, for the rest of us, at least some of the time.
It is tied up with stories and our seemingly ______ need for stories.
Have you ever been ______ by a story where nothing goes wrong for the characters?
There's an ______ in a Kingsley Amis novel that nicely ______ this: the main character Jake comes home to find his wife chatting to a friend about a hairdresser both women know who has moved with his family to somewhere in Africa.
Jake listens in, expecting tales of cannibalism and such like, but no, the friend has just received a letter saying they love the place and are settling in nicely.
Jake leaves the room in ______ .
We demand to be entertained, and while we don't object to a happy ending, the characters have to have experienced loss, pain and hardship in one form or another along the way to have ______ it.

答案:
1. insatiable
2. gripped
3. incident
4. illustrates
5. disgust
6. deserved

sense_groups.english: "No news is good news" may be true for most of us most of the time
sense_groups.chinese: ‘没有消息就是好消息’对我们大多数人来说，在大多数时候可能是真的

sense_groups.english: - after all, we don't look forward to unpleasant things happening to us
sense_groups.chinese: ——毕竟，我们并不期待不愉快的事情发生在我们身上

sense_groups.english: - but "Bad news is good news" is true for those who work in the news media
sense_groups.chinese: ——但‘坏消息就是好消息’对于在新闻媒体工作的人来说是真的

sense_groups.english: and, I suspect, for the rest of us, at least some of the time.
sense_groups.chinese: 而且我怀疑，对我们其他人来说，至少在某些时候也是如此。

sense_groups.english: It is tied up with stories and our seemingly ______ need for stories.
sense_groups.chinese: 这与故事以及我们看似______的故事需求有关。

sense_groups.english: Have you ever been ______ by a story where nothing goes wrong for the characters?
sense_groups.chinese: 你是否曾被一个角色从未出过差错的故事所______？

sense_groups.english: There's an ______ in a Kingsley Amis novel that nicely ______ this:
sense_groups.chinese: 在金斯利·艾米斯的小说中有一个______很好地______了这一点：

sense_groups.english: the main character Jake comes home to find his wife chatting to a friend about a hairdresser both women know who has moved with his family to somewhere in Africa.
sense_groups.chinese: 主角杰克回到家，发现妻子正在和一个朋友聊天，谈论她们都认识的一位理发师，他带着家人搬到了非洲的某个地方。

sense_groups.english: Jake listens in, expecting tales of cannibalism and such like,
sense_groups.chinese: 杰克偷听着，期待听到食人故事之类的事情，

sense_groups.english: but no, the friend has just received a letter saying they love the place and are settling in nicely.
sense_groups.chinese: 但并没有，朋友刚收到一封信，说他们喜欢那个地方，并且安顿得很好。

sense_groups.english: Jake leaves the room in ______ .
sense_groups.chinese: 杰克______地离开了房间。

sense_groups.english: We demand to be entertained,
sense_groups.chinese: 我们要求被娱乐，

sense_groups.english: and while we don't object to a happy ending,
sense_groups.chinese: 虽然我们不反对大团圆结局，

sense_groups.english: the characters have to have experienced loss, pain and hardship in one form or another along the way to have ______ it.
sense_groups.chinese: 但角色必须在过程中以某种形式经历过失去、痛苦和艰辛，才能______它。

questions.name: #319 Leisure Travel
questions.en:
Leisure travel was, in a sense, a British invention.
This was ______ due to economic and social factors; Britain was the first country to become fully industrialized, and industrial society offered ______ numbers of people time for leisure.
This, coupled with improvements in transport, especially the railways, meant that large numbers of people could get to holiday resorts in a very short time.
Modern mass tourism of a sort we can easily recognize today began in 1841 when Thomas Cook organized the first ______ tour, in which everything was included in the cost - travel, hotel and entertainment.
To cater for the large numbers of new holiday-makers, holiday camps were established, both on the coast and in the countryside, and they became ______ popular.
Their popularity declined, however, with the rise of cheap overseas tours, which gave many people their first opportunity to travel abroad .
questions.full:
Leisure travel was, in a sense, a British invention.
This was ______ due to economic and social factors; Britain was the first country to become fully industrialized, and industrial society offered ______ numbers of people time for leisure.
This, coupled with improvements in transport, especially the railways, meant that large numbers of people could get to holiday resorts in a very short time.
Modern mass tourism of a sort we can easily recognize today began in 1841 when Thomas Cook organized the first ______ tour, in which everything was included in the cost - travel, hotel and entertainment.
To cater for the large numbers of new holiday-makers, holiday camps were established, both on the coast and in the countryside, and they became ______ popular.
Their popularity declined, however, with the rise of cheap overseas tours, which gave many people their first opportunity to travel abroad .

答案:
1. mainly
2. growing
3. package
4. immensely

sense_groups.english: Leisure travel was, in a sense, a British invention.
sense_groups.chinese: 从某种意义上说，休闲旅行是英国人的发明。

sense_groups.english: This was ______ due to economic and social factors;
sense_groups.chinese: 这主要是由于经济和社会因素；

sense_groups.english: Britain was the first country to become fully industrialized,
sense_groups.chinese: 英国是第一个完全工业化的国家，

sense_groups.english: and industrial society offered ______ numbers of people time for leisure.
sense_groups.chinese: 工业社会为越来越多的人提供了休闲时间。

sense_groups.english: This, coupled with improvements in transport, especially the railways,
sense_groups.chinese: 这一点，加上交通的改善，尤其是铁路，

sense_groups.english: meant that large numbers of people could get to holiday resorts in a very short time.
sense_groups.chinese: 意味着大量的人可以在很短的时间内到达度假胜地。

sense_groups.english: Modern mass tourism of a sort we can easily recognize today began in 1841
sense_groups.chinese: 我们今天很容易识别的那种现代大众旅游始于1841年，

sense_groups.english: when Thomas Cook organized the first ______ tour,
sense_groups.chinese: 当时托马斯·库克组织了第一次包价旅游，

sense_groups.english: in which everything was included in the cost - travel, hotel and entertainment.
sense_groups.chinese: 费用包含了所有项目——交通、住宿和娱乐。

sense_groups.english: To cater for the large numbers of new holiday-makers,
sense_groups.chinese: 为了满足大量新度假者的需求，

sense_groups.english: holiday camps were established, both on the coast and in the countryside,
sense_groups.chinese: 在海岸和乡村都建立了度假营地，

sense_groups.english: and they became ______ popular.
sense_groups.chinese: 它们变得非常受欢迎。

sense_groups.english: Their popularity declined, however, with the rise of cheap overseas tours,
sense_groups.chinese: 然而，随着廉价海外旅游的兴起，它们的受欢迎程度下降了，

sense_groups.english: which gave many people their first opportunity to travel abroad .
sense_groups.chinese: 这给了许多人第一次出国旅游的机会。

questions.name: #320 Society
questions.en:
When societies were still mostly rural and agricultural, waste ______ was hardly an issue, partly because people tended to make use of everything and partly because there was plenty of space to bury rubbish.
It was when societies became predominantly urban and ______ that problems arose - mainly to do with ______ .
City authorities had a hard time trying to find ______ ways of getting rid of all the rubbish.
One of these was to get people to ______ out their rubbish into different types, just as these days we are encouraged to separate our rubbish into different categories for easier removal and recycling.
So, for example, kitchen rubbish was set aside and used for feeding animals.
However, fears of disease put an end to that.
In fact, it wasn't until the 20th century that all waste was simply thrown together and ______ into landfills.
questions.answer:
1. disposal
2. industrial
3. health
4. efficient
5. sort
6. ploughed
questions.full:
When societies were still mostly rural and agricultural, waste ______ was hardly an issue, partly because people tended to make use of everything and partly because there was plenty of space to bury rubbish.
It was when societies became predominantly urban and ______ that problems arose - mainly to do with ______ .
City authorities had a hard time trying to find ______ ways of getting rid of all the rubbish.
One of these was to get people to ______ out their rubbish into different types, just as these days we are encouraged to separate our rubbish into different categories for easier removal and recycling.
So, for example, kitchen rubbish was set aside and used for feeding animals.
However, fears of disease put an end to that.
In fact, it wasn't until the 20th century that all waste was simply thrown together and ______ into landfills.

答案:
1. disposal
2. industrial
3. health
4. efficient
5. sort
6. ploughed

sense_groups.english: When societies were still mostly rural and agricultural, waste disposal was hardly an issue,
sense_groups.chinese: 当社会还主要是农村和农业时，废物处理几乎不是问题，

sense_groups.english: partly because people tended to make use of everything
sense_groups.chinese: 部分原因是人们倾向于利用一切东西，

sense_groups.english: and partly because there was plenty of space to bury rubbish.
sense_groups.chinese: 部分原因是有足够的空间掩埋垃圾。

sense_groups.english: It was when societies became predominantly urban and industrial that problems arose
sense_groups.chinese: 正是当社会变得以城市和工业为主时，问题出现了，

sense_groups.english: - mainly to do with health.
sense_groups.chinese: ——主要与健康有关。

sense_groups.english: City authorities had a hard time trying to find efficient ways of getting rid of all the rubbish.
sense_groups.chinese: 城市当局很难找到有效的方法来处理所有垃圾。

sense_groups.english: One of these was to get people to sort out their rubbish into different types,
sense_groups.chinese: 其中一种方法是让人们把垃圾分类，

sense_groups.english: just as these days we are encouraged to separate our rubbish into different categories for easier removal and recycling.
sense_groups.chinese: 就像现在鼓励我们把垃圾分类以便于处理和回收一样。

sense_groups.english: So, for example, kitchen rubbish was set aside and used for feeding animals.
sense_groups.chinese: 例如，厨房垃圾被单独存放用来喂动物。

sense_groups.english: However, fears of disease put an end to that.
sense_groups.chinese: 然而，对疾病的恐惧结束了这种做法。

sense_groups.english: In fact, it wasn't until the 20th century that all waste was simply thrown together and ploughed into landfills.
sense_groups.chinese: 事实上，直到20世纪，所有垃圾才被简单地堆在一起并填埋到垃圾场。

questions.name: #321 Archery
questions.en:
Archery, the practice or art of shooting with a bow and arrow, has played an important part in English history, being the ______ weapon of the foot-soldier and instrumental in winning many battles in wars with the French - with whom we seemed to be ______ at war during the Middle Ages.
The English ______ the longbow over the short bow and the crossbow, the latter being the main firearm of ______ on the European continent.
The crossbow fired a metal bolt released by a trigger, rather like a gun, and had the ______ range of any of the bows, but the main advantage of the longbow was its accuracy.
The importance placed on archery is illustrated by the fact that medieval kings in England encouraged the practice and one of them, Edward III, went so far as to ______ all sports on Sundays and holidays except archery.
Because there were no standing armies in those days, and in the event of war rulers had to call on the populace, everything was done to make sure there were large numbers of competent, if not expert archers, to recruit.
questions.answer:
1. main
2. constantly
3. favored
4. militaries
5. longest
6. ban
questions.full:
Archery, the practice or art of shooting with a bow and arrow, has played an important part in English history, being the ______ weapon of the foot-soldier and instrumental in winning many battles in wars with the French - with whom we seemed to be ______ at war during the Middle Ages.
The English ______ the longbow over the short bow and the crossbow, the latter being the main firearm of ______ on the European continent.
The crossbow fired a metal bolt released by a trigger, rather like a gun, and had the ______ range of any of the bows, but the main advantage of the longbow was its accuracy.
The importance placed on archery is illustrated by the fact that medieval kings in England encouraged the practice and one of them, Edward III, went so far as to ______ all sports on Sundays and holidays except archery.
Because there were no standing armies in those days, and in the event of war rulers had to call on the populace, everything was done to make sure there were large numbers of competent, if not expert archers, to recruit.

答案:
1. main
2. constantly
3. favored
4. militaries
5. longest
6. ban

sense_groups.english: Archery, the practice or art of shooting with a bow and arrow,
sense_groups.chinese: 射箭，即使用弓箭进行射击的实践或艺术，

sense_groups.english: has played an important part in English history,
sense_groups.chinese: 在英国历史上扮演了重要角色，

sense_groups.english: being the main weapon of the foot-soldier
sense_groups.chinese: 是步兵的主要武器

sense_groups.english: and instrumental in winning many battles in wars with the French
sense_groups.chinese: 并在与法国人的战争中帮助赢得了许多战役

sense_groups.english: - with whom we seemed to be constantly at war during the Middle Ages.
sense_groups.chinese: ——在中世纪，我们似乎一直与他们处于战争状态。

sense_groups.english: The English favored the longbow over the short bow and the crossbow,
sense_groups.chinese: 英国人偏爱长弓而非短弓和十字弓，

sense_groups.english: the latter being the main firearm of militaries on the European continent.
sense_groups.chinese: 后者是欧洲大陆军队的主要火器。

sense_groups.english: The crossbow fired a metal bolt released by a trigger, rather like a gun,
sense_groups.chinese: 十字弓通过扳机发射金属箭矢，很像枪，

sense_groups.english: and had the longest range of any of the bows,
sense_groups.chinese: 并且是所有弓中射程最远的，

sense_groups.english: but the main advantage of the longbow was its accuracy.
sense_groups.chinese: 但长弓的主要优势在于其准确性。

sense_groups.english: The importance placed on archery is illustrated by the fact
sense_groups.chinese: 射箭的重要性体现在这样一个事实上：

sense_groups.english: that medieval kings in England encouraged the practice

questions.full:
The idea is that we divide the ward - the patients if you like - and the nurses into three different teams, which we call ______ nursing teams.
And in those teams we then have the primary nurse which is myself, associate nurses which ______ tend to be D grade nurses, and health care ______ , and you're all in one team together.
The idea is that you would hopefully work as a team in co-ordinating the care for the patients who come in under your care as in the red team.
In our teams we have eight patients each.

sense_groups.english: The idea is that we divide the ward - the patients if you like - and the nurses into three different teams, which we call primary nursing teams.
sense_groups.chinese: 这个想法是，我们把病房——如果你愿意的话，病人——和护士分成三个不同的团队，我们称之为初级护理团队。

sense_groups.english: And in those teams we then have the primary nurse which is myself, associate nurses which generally tend to be D grade nurses, and health care assistant, and you're all in one team together.
sense_groups.chinese: 在这些团队中，我们有初级护士（也就是我自己）、副护士（通常倾向于D级护士）和健康护理助理，你们都在同一个团队里。

sense_groups.english: The idea is that you would hopefully work as a team in co-ordinating the care for the patients who come in under your care as in the red team.
sense_groups.chinese: 这个想法是，你们希望作为一个团队来协调护理那些属于你们负责的病人，比如红队。

sense_groups.english: In our teams we have eight patients each.
sense_groups.chinese: 在我们的团队中，每个团队有八名病人。

sense_groups.english: The idea would be that I would normally prescribe the care or plan the care, for those patients.
sense_groups.chinese: 通常，我会为这些病人制定护理计划或安排护理。

sense_groups.english: In reality, it doesn't always work like that and besides which the associate nurses that are in the teams have those skills anyway from their training.
sense_groups.chinese: 实际上，并不总是这样，而且团队中的副护士从他们的培训中已经具备了这些技能。

questions.full:

The heritage that we speak about in this country in terms of conservation tends to be a term that becomes very central - or more central in new ways - as the state becomes ______ in this field of administering conservation.

答案:
1. defined
2. threat
3. economic
4. involved

sense_groups.english: Heritage is what the present chooses to make of the past.
sense_groups.chinese: 遗产是当下选择对过去进行诠释的结果。

sense_groups.english: That means that heritage is dynamic.
sense_groups.chinese: 这意味着遗产是动态的。

sense_groups.english: It’s a challenging / changing concept.
sense_groups.chinese: 这是一个具有挑战性/不断变化的概念。

sense_groups.english: And it also means that it tends to be defined in opposition to much that is going on in the present.
sense_groups.chinese: 这也意味着它往往被定义为与当下发生的许多事情相对立。

sense_groups.english: It's endangered.
sense_groups.chinese: 它处于危险之中。

sense_groups.english: Where there is heritage, there is often a sense of threat, you know, whether it's a building that's about to be bull-dozed, or a way of life that is dying out because of economic change.
sense_groups.chinese: 哪里有遗产，哪里就常常有威胁感，你知道，无论是即将被推土机铲平的建筑，还是因经济变革而消亡的生活方式。

sense_groups.english: The heritage that we speak about in this country in terms of conservation tends to be a term that becomes very central - or more central in new ways - as the state becomes involved in this field of administering conservation.
sense_groups.chinese: 我们在这个国家谈论的关于保护的遗产，往往成为一个非常核心的术语——或者以新的方式变得更加核心——随着国家介入这一保护管理领域。

questions.full:

sense_groups.english: By way of introduction, Joseph Heller, the author who introduced the phrase 'Catch-22' into the English language, died on December 12th at the age of 76 in his home in East Hampton, New York.
sense_groups.chinese: 首先介绍，约瑟夫·海勒，将‘第二十二条军规’这一短语引入英语的作者，于12月12日去世，享年76岁，地点在纽约东汉普顿的家中。

sense_groups.english: In 1961, Heller published his first novel, Catch-22, a surreal anti-war story set in World War II.
sense_groups.chinese: 1961年，海勒出版了他的第一部小说《第二十二条军规》，这是一部以二战为背景的超现实主义反战故事。

sense_groups.chinese: 海勒标题中的‘第二十二条军规’是指，当一个人认识到自己的状况时，他就不再是精神失常了。

sense_groups.english: The principal organs of the United Nations, as specified in the Charter,

sense_groups.english: are the General Assembly, the Security Council, the Economic and Social Council, the Trusteeship Council, the International Court of Justice, and the Secretariat.

questions.name: #358 Red Fruit

There is something hard to resist about ______ .

questions.full:

sense_groups.english: There is something hard to resist about cherries .
sense_groups.chinese: 樱桃有一种难以抗拒的魅力。

sense_groups.english: The small red fruit is a popular seasonal food around the world .

sense_groups.english: In northern areas, cherry trees are just beginning to produce flowers.
sense_groups.chinese: 在北方地区，樱桃树刚刚开始开花。

sense_groups.english: The cherry is a member of the same family of plants as the rose.

sense_groups.english: It is closely related to the plum.

sense_groups.english: There are two major kinds of cherries harvested in the world: sweet and sour.

sense_groups.english: Sour cherries are not eaten fresh because they contain little sugar.

sense_groups.chinese: 在各州中，密歇根州是最大的生产地。

questions.name: #359 Clock
questions.en:
If you can read a clock, you can know the time of ______ .
But no one knows what time itself is.
We cannot see it.
We cannot ______ it.
We cannot hear it.
We know it only by the way we mark its passing.
For all our success in measuring the smallest parts of time, time remains one of the great ______ of the universe.
One way to think about time is to imagine a world without time.
There could be no ______ because time and movement cannot be ______ .
A world without time could exist only as long as there were no changes.
For time and change are linked.
We know that time has passed when something changes.
questions.full:
If you can read a clock, you can know the time of ______ .
But no one knows what time itself is.
We cannot see it.
We cannot ______ it.
We cannot hear it.
We know it only by the way we mark its passing.
For all our success in measuring the smallest parts of time, time remains one of the great ______ of the universe.
One way to think about time is to imagine a world without time.
There could be no ______ because time and movement cannot be ______ .
A world without time could exist only as long as there were no changes.
For time and change are linked.
We know that time has passed when something changes.

答案:
1. day
2. touch
3. mysteries
4. movement
5. separated

sense_groups.english: If you can read a clock, you can know the time of day.
sense_groups.chinese: 如果你会看钟，你就能知道一天中的时间。

sense_groups.english: But no one knows what time itself is.
sense_groups.chinese: 但没有人知道时间本身是什么。

sense_groups.english: We cannot see it.
sense_groups.chinese: 我们看不见它。

sense_groups.english: We cannot touch it.
sense_groups.chinese: 我们摸不到它。

sense_groups.english: We cannot hear it.
sense_groups.chinese: 我们听不到它。

sense_groups.english: We know it only by the way we mark its passing.
sense_groups.chinese: 我们只能通过标记它的流逝来认识它。

sense_groups.english: For all our success in measuring the smallest parts of time, time remains one of the great mysteries of the universe.
sense_groups.chinese: 尽管我们在测量时间的最小部分上取得了成功，时间仍然是宇宙中最大的谜团之一。

sense_groups.english: One way to think about time is to imagine a world without time.
sense_groups.chinese: 思考时间的一种方式是想象一个没有时间的世界。

sense_groups.english: There could be no movement because time and movement cannot be separated.
sense_groups.chinese: 不可能有运动，因为时间和运动是不可分割的。

sense_groups.english: A world without time could exist only as long as there were no changes.
sense_groups.chinese: 一个没有时间的世界只有在没有变化的情况下才能存在。

sense_groups.english: For time and change are linked.
sense_groups.chinese: 因为时间和变化是联系在一起的。

sense_groups.english: We know that time has passed when something changes.
sense_groups.chinese: 当某物发生变化时，我们就知道时间已经过去了。

questions.full:

In the ______ United States, winter can mean the return of snow.

One storm hit the East Coast, causing flight cancellations and temporarily stopping traffic in ______ areas.
Snow is a subject of great interest to weather experts.

sense_groups.english: Winter has returned to the northern parts of the world.
sense_groups.chinese: 冬天已经回到了世界的北部地区。

sense_groups.english: In the northern United States, winter can mean the return of snow.
sense_groups.chinese: 在美国北部，冬天意味着雪的回归。

sense_groups.english: Large amounts of snow fell in some American cities last month.
sense_groups.chinese: 上个月，美国一些城市降下了大量的雪。

sense_groups.english: One storm hit the East Coast, causing flight cancellations and temporarily stopping traffic in some areas.
sense_groups.chinese: 一场暴风雨袭击了东海岸，导致航班取消，并暂时停止了某些地区的交通。

sense_groups.english: Snow is a subject of great interest to weather experts.
sense_groups.chinese: 雪是气象专家非常感兴趣的话题。

sense_groups.english: They sometimes have difficulty estimating where, when, or how much snow will fall.
sense_groups.chinese: 他们有时难以估计雪会在哪里、何时以及下多少。

sense_groups.english: One reason is that heavy amounts of snow fall in surprisingly small areas.
sense_groups.chinese: 一个原因是大量的雪会降落在出奇小的区域内。

sense_groups.english: Another reason is that a small change in temperature can mean the difference between snow and rain.
sense_groups.chinese: 另一个原因是温度的微小变化可能意味着雪和雨的区别。

sense_groups.english: An allergy is an ______ strong reaction to a substance.

sense_groups.english: The most common cause is pollen.

sense_groups.english: Trees usually produce pollen in the spring, grasses in the summer, and weeds in the ______ as part of their reproductive process.

sense_groups.english: Other causes include organisms such as dust mites and molds.

sense_groups.english: Chemicals, plants and ______ skin particles from dogs and cats can also cause allergic reactions.

sense_groups.english: The most common kind of allergic reaction is itchy, watery ______ , and a blocked or watery nose.

sense_groups.chinese: 过敏也可能______发红、发痒的皮肤。

sense_groups.english: Some reactions can be life-threatening—for example, when breathing passages become blocked.
sense_groups.chinese: 有些反应可能危及生命——例如，当呼吸道被堵塞时。

questions.en:

questions.full:
Cats are the ______ popular pets among Americans.
So it is not surprising that there are many expressions about cats.
Some cats like to ______ small birds, like canaries.
If someone looks very proud or satisfied with himself, we say he looks like the cat that ate the canary.
Sometimes, a cat likes to ______ with a small animal it catches.
So if you play cat and mouse with someone, you change between different kinds of behavior when dealing with another person.
For example, a child might offer something sweet to her little brother and then take it away when he reaches for it.
A cat will often catch a small animal and present it to its owner.

答案:

2. catch
3. play
4. describes

sense_groups.english: Cats are the most popular pets among Americans.
sense_groups.chinese: 猫是美国人最受欢迎的宠物。

sense_groups.english: So it is not surprising that there are many expressions about cats.
sense_groups.chinese: 所以有很多关于猫的表达也就不足为奇了。

sense_groups.english: Some cats like to catch small birds, like canaries.
sense_groups.chinese: 有些猫喜欢捕捉小鸟，比如金丝雀。

sense_groups.english: If someone looks very proud or satisfied with himself, we say he looks like the cat that ate the canary.
sense_groups.chinese: 如果有人看起来非常自豪或自满，我们就说他看起来像吃了金丝雀的猫。

sense_groups.english: Sometimes, a cat likes to play with a small animal it catches.
sense_groups.chinese: 有时，猫喜欢玩弄它抓到的小动物。

sense_groups.english: So if you play cat and mouse with someone, you change between different kinds of behavior when dealing with another person.
sense_groups.chinese: 所以如果你和某人玩猫捉老鼠的游戏，你在与另一个人打交道时会改变不同的行为方式。

sense_groups.english: For example, a child might offer something sweet to her little brother and then take it away when he reaches for it.
sense_groups.chinese: 例如，一个孩子可能会给她的小弟弟一些甜的东西，然后在他伸手去拿时又拿走。

sense_groups.english: A cat will often catch a small animal and present it to its owner.
sense_groups.chinese: 猫常常会抓到小动物并送给主人。

sense_groups.english: The saying that looks like something the cat dragged in describes something in bad condition.
sense_groups.chinese: “看起来像猫拖进来的东西”这个说法描述的是状况糟糕的东西。

questions.name: #364 Einstein
questions.en:
For thousands of years, philosophers and astronomers and thinkers of all sorts have imagined that the ______ , the space around us was rather like this floor in front of us.
It was fixed and unchangeable and things happen on it, just as people walk around.
So the stars, the ______ , and the planets, and the other heavenly bodies moved around and traced down their parts on this completely unchanging stage of space.
In the 20th century, as the result of Einstein’s work, that view of the universe was completely transformed.
We began to understand that there was no absolutely fixed ______ of space at all on which all celestial notions were played out.
But in some sense on the larger scale in the universe, the space itself was in this state of a continuous ______ change.
That was a prediction made by Einstein, but wasn't Einstein held the honor of making the discovery that the universe was really like that.
questions.full:
For thousands of years, philosophers and astronomers and thinkers of all sorts have imagined that the ______ , the space around us was rather like this floor in front of us.
It was fixed and unchangeable and things happen on it, just as people walk around.
So the stars, the ______ , and the planets, and the other heavenly bodies moved around and traced down their parts on this completely unchanging stage of space.
In the 20th century, as the result of Einstein’s work, that view of the universe was completely transformed.
We began to understand that there was no absolutely fixed ______ of space at all on which all celestial notions were played out.
But in some sense on the larger scale in the universe, the space itself was in this state of a continuous ______ change.
That was a prediction made by Einstein, but wasn't Einstein held the honor of making the discovery that the universe was really like that.

答案:
1. universe
2. comets
3. stage
4. dynamic

sense_groups.english: For thousands of years, philosophers and astronomers and thinkers of all sorts have imagined that the universe, the space around us was rather like this floor in front of us.
sense_groups.chinese: 几千年来，哲学家、天文学家和各种思想家都曾想象，宇宙，我们周围的空间，就像我们面前的这块地板。

sense_groups.english: It was fixed and unchangeable and things happen on it, just as people walk around.
sense_groups.chinese: 它是固定不变的，事情在上面发生，就像人们走来走去一样。

sense_groups.english: So the stars, the comets, and the planets, and the other heavenly bodies moved around and traced down their parts on this completely unchanging stage of space.
sense_groups.chinese: 所以恒星、彗星、行星和其他天体在这个完全不变的宇宙舞台上移动，扮演着各自的角色。

sense_groups.english: In the 20th century, as the result of Einstein’s work, that view of the universe was completely transformed.
sense_groups.chinese: 20世纪，由于爱因斯坦的工作，这种宇宙观被彻底改变了。

sense_groups.english: We began to understand that there was no absolutely fixed stage of space at all on which all celestial notions were played out.
sense_groups.chinese: 我们开始明白，根本不存在一个绝对固定的宇宙舞台，所有天体活动都在上面上演。

sense_groups.english: But in some sense on the larger scale in the universe, the space itself was in this state of a continuous dynamic change.
sense_groups.chinese: 但在某种意义上，在宇宙更大的尺度上，空间本身处于一种持续动态变化的状态。

sense_groups.english: That was a prediction made by Einstein, but wasn't Einstein held the honor of making the discovery that the universe was really like that.
sense_groups.chinese: 这是爱因斯坦做出的预测，但并非爱因斯坦享有发现宇宙真实面貌的荣誉。
